app.tagline: Claw back your inbox and your money.
app.local: Runs only on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
flow.label: Steps
connect.title: Where is your email?
connect.lead: Private inbox cleanup on this computer. Nothing changes until you confirm twice.
connect.trust: Two clicks for every change|Runs on this computer|Nothing is uploaded
connect.takeout.title: Import a Google Takeout export
connect.takeout.steps: takeout.google.com: Deselect all, tick Mail, Create export|Download the .zip Google emails you|Choose it below
connect.takeout.path: …or paste the path to a file or a folder of .eml files
connect.takeout.uploading: Copying {pct}% into your private Clawback folder…
connect.gmail.title: Gmail
connect.gmail.fast.title: Fast scan (about a minute)
connect.gmail.fast.body: Reads Gmail over IMAP with a Google app password: no per-minute limit, so it is much faster. Needs 2-Step Verification, and the app password can read and send all your mail until you revoke it. Clawback only reads.
connect.gmail.xoauth2.title: Advanced: sign in with Google instead of an app password
connect.gmail.xoauth2.warning: Full mailbox access: this asks Google for the https://mail.google.com/ permission, which can read, send and permanently delete all your Gmail. Clawback only reads with it. Revoke it any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
connect.gmail.xoauth2.use: Use Google sign-in for the fast scan
connect.gmail.xoauth2.ack: I understand this grants full mailbox access
connect.gmail.oauth.title: Sign in with Google (10 to 15 min the first time)
connect.gmail.body: One Google sign-in for scanning and cleanup. The first scan is slower because Google limits how much an app may read per minute (10 to 15 minutes for 3,000 emails); next scans take seconds. Needs a free Google Cloud OAuth client: see the README.
connect.gmail.missing: No OAuth client yet. Save client_secret.json in your Clawback data folder (README: "Connect Gmail").
connect.gmail.sameAccount: An address used here before reopens its saved results.
connect.gmail.waiting: Finish signing in in the browser tab Google opened…
connect.imap.title: Other email (IMAP)
connect.imap.body: Yahoo, iCloud, AOL, Zoho, Fastmail, GMX, Yandex, Proton (through Proton Mail Bridge) or any other provider. Use an app password, not your normal password.
connect.imap.send: Allow sending unsubscribe emails over SMTP
connect.demo.title: Try the demo
scan.title: Scanning {account}
scan.partial: Partial: scanned back to {date} ({n} emails so far). Results keep growing until the scan finishes.
scan.partialPriority: Partial results: {n} emails read so far. Likely subscriptions and newsletters are read first, so the date reached shows once that part is done. Results keep growing until the scan finishes.
scan.partialNoDate: Partial results: {n} emails read so far. Results keep growing until the scan finishes.
scan.hint.firstApi: Reading all your Gmail is the slow part: Google limits how much an app may read per minute, so about 3,000 emails take 10 to 15 minutes. Next scans only read new mail and usually take seconds.
scan.hint.firstImap: Next scans only read new mail and usually take seconds.
scan.hint.rescan: Only new mail is read; emails from earlier scans are skipped.
scan.hint.next: Next scans only read new mail, so they usually take seconds.
scan.hint.rescanDone: Only new mail was read: {messages} new, {reused} from earlier scans skipped.
scan.lead: You can leave this page; results appear below as they're found.
scan.failedTitle: The last scan stopped before it finished
scan.noReason: The scan stopped without giving a reason. Nothing in your mailbox was changed; try again.
scan.failedBody: Scanning only reads mail, so nothing in your mailbox was changed. Fix the problem above and try again, or connect another mailbox.
scan.stoppedEarly: This scan was stopped before it finished, so these results may be incomplete. Scan again to read the rest.
guide.newsletter: Most emails first. Unsubscribe or delete a sender in two clicks, or tick several. Nothing happens until you confirm.
guide.paid: Set a subscription to Cancelled once you have cancelled it, to count your savings. Clawback opens cancel pages; it does not cancel for you.
important.hint: Bank and card alerts, statements, security, government and work mail. Clawback keeps these and never suggests unsubscribing.
important.actWarn: These look important. Acting on them could hide alerts you need.
review.ackImportant: I understand this looks important, include it anyway
tabs.label: Results
savings.emails: {n} senders silenced · about {perMonth} fewer emails a month
savings.emailsOne: 1 sender silenced · about {perMonth} fewer emails a month
savings.estimate: Estimates from your email history. Check your statements for exact figures.
savings.title: You've clawed back
flags.unknownDomain: Unsubscribe goes to an unknown domain ({domain})
flags.whyUnknown: {domain} isn't the sender ({sender}), isn't on Clawback's list of known email providers, and didn't sign this email. Companies often use a mailing service for unsubscribes, so this can be fine, but check the sender first. Block is always safe.
saved.title: Your saved accounts
saved.lead: Accounts this computer already knows. Open one to see its results; accounts with a saved sign-in reconnect without asking again.
saved.resultsOnly: No sign-in is saved for it (passwords never are): its results open read-only; connect it again to scan.
saved.copy: A second saved copy of {main} (kept under the name "{label}"); signing in again uses {main}.
scan.droppedBody: Nothing changed: you are still looking at {account}, and its results are as they were.
scan.droppedBodyNone: Nothing was saved for it. Check the details below and connect again.
results.notScannedBody: Clawback has no results for this account yet. Scan it to find your paid subscriptions and newsletters; nothing is changed in your mailbox.
bodylink.none: No unsubscribe link in the latest email from {name}. Block keeps its mail out of your inbox.
bodylink.copy: Copy the unsubscribe link from {name}'s email
bodylink.copied: Link copied. Check where it goes before you open it.
bodylink.topup: Looking inside emails for unsubscribe links: {done} of {total} senders checked, {found} found.
actions.notOpened: Select the ones you haven't opened in {months} months
actions.spamHint: Unsubscribing from spam confirms your address is read. Block or report these instead.
review.ack: I checked this sender; include it
review.nothing: Nothing in this selection can run.
review.dry: Practice mode: nothing will be contacted or changed.
done.next: Next: Clawback checks whether these senders stop mailing you. See "Did it work?" after your next scan.
done.title: Here's what happened
done.finishThere: Finish on the page that opens
paid.loansNote: Loan repayments found in your bank alerts. They are not subscriptions: Clawback leaves them out of what you pay and save. Talk to your lender to change them.
insights.title: Heads-up
proof.lead: After you unsubscribe, Clawback checks whether the sender keeps mailing. Senders get 2 days for one-click (Google recommends 48 hours) and 10 business days otherwise (CAN-SPAM).
proof.rescan: Waiting for newer mail: scan or import again later to check.
proof.linkNote: Web-page unsubscribes only work if you finished the steps on that page.
privacy.lead: Companies that have your email address, by how much they send. Draft a deletion request for any of them.
privacy.name: Your name
privacy.email: Email address they know you by
privacy.to: Their privacy contact (from their privacy notice)
activity.lead: Every action Clawback took, on this computer only.
settings.title: Settings
settings.converted: Show a combined total in my home currency (uses only rates I enter)
settings.rates: Rates: one per line, e.g. USD=83.20 (units of home currency per 1 unit)
settings.grace2: Grace business days for other unsubscribes
settings.keep: Keep-list (never suggested): addresses or @domains, one per line
offline.title: Clawback stopped running on this computer
offline.body: This page only talks to the Clawback program on your computer, and it is not answering any more (for example its terminal window was closed, or the computer went to sleep). Nothing in your mailbox was changed.
offline.start: To continue, start it again: in a terminal, run
offline.scanKept: The scan that was running stopped with it. The emails it had already saved are kept (it saves as it goes), so scanning again continues from there instead of starting over.
offline.scanFile: The scan that was running stopped with it. A file import or the demo is read again from the start when you scan it again.
offline.waiting: This page reloads by itself as soon as Clawback is back. If clawback ui opens a new page, you can use that one and close this one.
offline.blip: Couldn't reach Clawback just now. Try again.
empty.newsletter.title: No newsletters or marketing senders found
empty.newsletter.body: Nothing to tidy up here. New senders appear after your next scan.
empty.spam.title: No spam-like senders found
empty.spam.body: Senders that look like spam are listed here, with Block and Report instead of Unsubscribe.
empty.important.title: Nothing marked important
empty.important.body: Bank and card alerts, statements, security, government and work mail show up here so you can keep them.
empty.paid.title: No paid subscriptions found
empty.paid.body: Clawback looks for receipts, renewal notices and payment alerts in the mail it read.
empty.proof.title: Nothing to check yet
empty.proof.body: After you unsubscribe from a sender, this tab shows whether they stopped mailing you.
empty.privacy.title: No companies found yet
empty.privacy.body: Scan a mailbox to see which companies have your email address.
empty.activity.title: No actions yet
empty.activity.body: Every action you confirm is listed here, with Undo where it can be undone.
empty.filter.title: No senders match “{q}”
empty.filter.body: Try another name or address, or clear the filter.
all.title: All accounts
all.lead: Results from {n} mailboxes together. A mailbox connected twice is counted once.
all.oneAccount: Choose one account to open cancellation pages
connect.imap.otherHelp: Enter your provider's IMAP server under Technical details. Their help pages list it, usually as imap.<provider>.
connect.imap.cafile: Extra certificate file (Proton Mail Bridge only)
connect.imap.techNote: Filled in from the provider's own help pages. Folders are found from the server's own list (Inbox, Archive, All Mail in any language); Spam, Trash and Sent are skipped. The certificate is always checked.
connect.imap.appPw: Make an app password on {name}'s page
connect.imap.useMicrosoft: Use Sign in with Microsoft instead
connect.ms.title: Sign in with Microsoft
connect.ms.body: For Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live and Microsoft 365. Microsoft switched off app passwords for these on 16 September 2024. One Microsoft sign-in covers scanning and cleanup.
connect.ms.setup: First time: set up your free app registration (about 5 minutes)
connect.ms.steps: Sign in at entra.microsoft.com with any Microsoft account and open App registrations > New registration.|Name it Clawback. Supported account types: Any Entra ID tenant and personal Microsoft accounts.|Redirect URI: choose Mobile and desktop applications and enter http://localhost, then Register.|Copy the Application (client) ID from the Overview page and paste it below.
connect.ms.docs: Microsoft's guide to registering an app
connect.ms.clientHint: Paste the ID from the Overview page
connect.ms.saved: Saved from last time (paste to change)
connect.ms.tenant.common: Personal and work or school accounts
connect.ms.techNote: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, no client secret; Microsoft returns to http://localhost on this computer. Permission Mail.Read for scanning; Mail.ReadWrite, Mail.Send or MailboxSettings.ReadWrite only when you turn on an action. Tokens stay in your Clawback data folder.
connect.ms.waiting: Finish signing in in the browser tab Microsoft opened…
connect.imap.bridgePw: Proton's guide to Proton Mail Bridge
scan.options.title: Scan {account} again
scan.options.quickDesc: Reads only the mail of the last 12 months that Clawback has not read yet, usually just what arrived since the last scan, so it normally takes seconds.
scan.options.firstDesc: All your mail from the last 12 months (since {date}). Later quick updates only read new mail.
scan.options.fullDesc: Read all mail from the last 12 months (since {date}) again, as if for the first time.
scan.options.fileDesc: Read the whole imported file again.
scan.options.demoDesc: Read the whole demo mailbox again.
scan.options.sinceDesc: All mail since the date you choose, however long ago. Emails read before are reused.
scan.options.lastDesc: Only your newest emails, however old. Emails read before are reused.
scan.options.lastLabel: How many of your newest emails
scan.options.badDate: Choose a date that is not in the future.
scan.options.badNumber: Enter a whole number of emails from 1 to 1,000,000.
scan.options.rereadGmail: This version sorts mail better (order and payment notices are no longer newsletters), using details it never saves, such as Gmail's tabs. So this one scan reads the chosen mail again, even a quick update: about 10 to 15 minutes for 3,000 emails. After it, quick updates take seconds again.
scan.options.reread: This version sorts mail better (order and payment notices are no longer newsletters), using details it never saves. So this one scan reads the chosen mail again, even a quick update. After it, quick updates take seconds again.
estimate.noOutlook: There is no time estimate for Outlook yet (it is experimental).
estimate.onlyNew: Only mail Clawback has not read yet is read.
estimate.saved: Based on the {n} emails saved from earlier scans of this period.
estimate.upToNew: Reads up to {n} emails that earlier scans did not read.
estimate.older: Mail that earlier scans read is reused; older mail back to {date} is read now, so the time depends on how much of it there is.
estimate.first.gmail: The first scan through Google sign-in is the slow one: Google limits how much an app may read per minute, so about 3,000 emails take 10 to 15 minutes. How many you have is known once the scan starts.
estimate.first.imap: Usually about a minute for 3,000 emails.
estimate.first.outlook: There is no time estimate for Outlook yet (it is experimental).
estimate.olderAll: Mail that earlier scans read is reused; all older mail is read now, so the time depends on how much of it there is.
estimate.file: An imported file is read whole each time; the time depends on its size.
estimate.demo: The demo mailbox is built in.
results.scope.last: That scan covered your newest {n} emails.
results.scope.quick: That scan covered emails since {date} (a quick update: only mail not read before was read).
results.scope.all: That scan covered all your emails.
results.scope.earlier: Results also include what earlier scans saved.
results.scope.partial: It was stopped before it finished, so older mail in that range was not read.
results.scope.capped: It stopped at the safety limit of emails before reaching that date, so older mail was not read.
scan.hint.upgradeApi: This version of Clawback sorts mail better, so this one scan reads all your mail in the window again: Google limits how much an app may read per minute (about 3,000 emails take 10 to 15 minutes). After this, quick updates only read new mail and take seconds.
scan.hint.upgrade: This version of Clawback sorts mail better, so this one scan reads all your mail in the window again. After this, quick updates only read new mail and take seconds.
glance.label: At a glance
guide.newsletterNoDelete: Most emails first. Unsubscribe from a sender in two clicks, or tick several. Nothing happens until you confirm.
sort.label: Sort
sort.name: Name (A to Z)
row.unsubscribe_trash: Unsubscribe from {name} and delete all {n} emails
sheet.line.trash.gmail: They go to Gmail Trash; you can restore them for 30 days.
sheet.line.trash.outlook: They go to Deleted Items in Outlook; you can restore them from there.
sheet.line.trash.demo: Demo mailbox: nothing real is deleted (simulated).
sheet.line.trash.other: They go to your Trash; you can restore them from there.
sheet.line.undoAfter: Nothing is deleted for good. Undo appears right after, and later in History.
sheet.line.unsubscribe: Clawback asks the sender to stop emailing you. This can't be undone from Clawback.
sheet.line.finish: For {n} of them a web page opens; you finish there.
sheet.line.finishOne: A web page opens; you finish there.
sheet.line.trashOnly: {n} senders have no safe way to unsubscribe, so their emails are only deleted.
sheet.line.trashOnlyOne: 1 sender has no safe way to unsubscribe, so its emails are only deleted.
sheet.line.archive: They leave your inbox but stay in your mailbox. Undo brings them back.
sheet.line.block: New mail from them skips your inbox (a filter in your mailbox). Undo removes the filter.
sheet.line.report_spam: They move to Spam. Undo moves them back.
sheet.line.escalate: A filter sends their future mail to Trash and their emails are reported as spam. Undo removes the filter.
sheet.line.open_cancel: The cancellation page opens in your browser; you cancel there. Clawback never cancels for you.
sheet.line.send_request: The request is sent from your account to the company.
sheet.line.undo: This puts back what the action changed.
toast.unsubscribe: Unsubscribed from {who}. This can't be undone; mail can take a few days to stop.
toast.unsubscribe_trash: Unsubscribed from {who} (can't be undone) and deleted {emails} emails.
toast.block: Blocked {who}: new mail skips your inbox.
toast.kept: Keeping {name}: it won't be suggested again.
toast.keptMany: Keeping {n} senders: they won't be suggested again.
perm.noteBody: Your Google sign-in only allows reading. Sign in once more and Clawback asks for everything it needs at once, so you won't be asked again.
perm.noteBodyMs: Your Microsoft sign-in only allows reading. Sign in once more and Clawback asks for everything it needs at once, so you won't be asked again.
perm.go: Sign in again to allow cleanup
perm.goMs: Sign in again to allow cleanup
perm.waiting: Waiting for Google… finish in the browser tab that opened.
perm.waitingMs: Waiting for Microsoft… finish in the browser tab that opened.
perm.done: Cleanup allowed. You won't be asked again.
perm.read.title: Read your email
perm.read.body: To find newsletters, spam-like senders and subscriptions. Read on this computer only.
perm.move.title: Move mail to Trash, Archive or Spam, and back
perm.move.body: Only for senders you confirm. Never deletes for good: Gmail keeps Trash for 30 days.
perm.filter.title: Create filters
perm.filter.body: Only for senders you choose to block.
perm.send.title: Send email
perm.send.body: Only an unsubscribe email you confirmed, to the address the sender gave for it.
perm.ms.read.body: To find newsletters, spam-like senders and subscriptions. Read on this computer only.
perm.ms.move.body: Only for senders you confirm. Mail goes to Deleted Items, never deleted for good.
perm.ms.filter.body: Only for senders you choose to block (an Outlook rule).
perm.ms.send.body: Only an unsubscribe email you confirmed, to the address the sender gave for it.
perm.connectFoot: Clawback uses each only after you confirm, and nothing leaves this computer. One sign-in covers scanning and cleanup.
perm.connectFootMs: Clawback uses each only after you confirm, and nothing leaves this computer. One sign-in covers scanning and cleanup.
perm.noDeleteFile: Imported from a file: Clawback can unsubscribe but can't delete. To delete too, connect the account with Google or Microsoft sign-in.
perm.noDeleteImap: App-password (IMAP) connection: Clawback can unsubscribe but can't delete yet. For Gmail or Outlook, connect with Google or Microsoft sign-in to delete too.
settings.practice: Practice mode: show and log what would happen, but contact nobody and change nothing
done.titleFinish: Almost done: finish on the page
connect.limits.file: Scan and unsubscribe. A file import can't delete mail.
connect.limits.imap: Scan and unsubscribe. Deleting over IMAP isn't built yet: for Gmail or Outlook, use Sign in with Google or Microsoft to delete too.
connect.gmail.short: One sign-in to scan and clean up. First scan 10 to 15 min, then seconds.
connect.gmail.fastFold: Faster first scan: Gmail app password (about a minute)
connect.ms.short: Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live and Microsoft 365. One sign-in to scan and clean up.
perm.noteShort: Your Google sign-in can only read.
perm.noteShortMs: Your Microsoft sign-in can only read.
actions.safetyMore: Pick an action, then press Confirm in the same place. Deleted mail goes to Trash, with Undo.
actions.spamShort: Block or delete these. Never unsubscribe from spam.
activity.leadShort: Every action, logged on this computer.
guide.paidShort: Mark one Cancelled once you've cancelled it to count savings.
proof.leadShort: Whether senders stopped after you unsubscribed.
privacy.leadShort: Who has your address. Draft a deletion request.
